events.verdict: Mack (MEM) engages with Beverley (LAC) and affects his FOM.
[Observable in enhanced video] Temple (MEM) takes more than two legal steps after gathering the ball.
Beverley (LAC) has a hand placed on Mack (MEM) in the lane, but the contact is marginal. The two players then briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Gasol (MEM) engages with Gallinari (LAC) but does not affect his ability to defend.

Beverley (LAC) makes contact with Gasol's (MEM) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Beverley (LAC) enters the area inside the three-point arc prior to the release of the free throw.
Mack (MEM) makes contact with Harrell's (LAC) elbow during his shooting motion on the play at the basket.
Beverley (LAC) wraps an arm around Gasol (MEM) and restricts his FOM during the pick.
Gasol (MEM) establishes legal position in Beverley's (LAC) path and firms up on his left leg when contact occurs.
